abstract: The modern healthcare monitoring system is getting benefited by new emerging technologies, such as tiny physiological sensors and the latest wireless technologies. The Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs) introduce live tracing of vital signs, online diagnosis, and various other advantages when compared with the traditional system. The duty cycle (wake-up and sleep) performs a crucial function in the conservation of the limited battery power of physiological sensors. A scheme is introduced in this paper that adjusts the duration of superframe in the beaconenable mode of IEEE 802.15.4 MAC. The proposed scheme’s key objective is to prolong the lifetime of the physiological sensor by altering superframe duration. Through extensive simulations, it is shown that the superframe duration may be appropriately adjusted to improve energy efficiency without significantly reducing network throughput.

articleTitle: Identification of Road and Surrounding Obstacles using U-Net Architecture for Better Perception
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The ability to understand the road and traffic layout is necessary to implement vision-based autonomous driving. The process involves detecting and classifying images of roads, pedestrians, vehicles, etc. Additionally, driving videos can be used to track different patterns of motion based on their spatial location. Temporal connections between lines show the arrangement of roads and their surroundings. For an accurate understanding of the road profile, it is highly required to identify its various areas; roads, roadside, lane marks, vehicles, etc., make up the road profile in real-time. This problem can be solved by segmenting the different objects into different classes. By categorizing each pixel in an image, image segmentation is accomplished. Also, Self-driving vehicles is a highly concentrated research field where most of the researchers, industries and startups are focusing these days. In order to provide perception to a vehicle there is a lot of other things to be taken into consideration. For an instance a human can classify the surrounding objects by its features the same way a computer or robot needs to understand its surroundings for better perception, the proposed experimentation works on semantic segmentation-based road and surrounding detection. In order to carry out the experimentation, a CNN based U-Net architecture is selected to achieve the semantic segmentation and detection of surrounding objects. For training and validating the model, various images from the simulated urban environment were employed. The U-Net model was found to be 95.7% accurate in the experiment.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Wetland Transformations using HSV Color Model for Denduluru Region
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Wetlands act as one of the major sources of food, water, and livelihood in terms of fisheries and aquaculture. Due to human activities and other climatic changes wetland regions are continuously decreasing. As a result, it is essential to conduct a wetlands inventory in a given region so that it can track changes over a time period. Many researchers proposed so many methodologies for detecting the water bodies transformations throughout the decade using some statistical, methodological, and rule-based algorithms. The currently proposed methodology uses multiple bands methods rather than single bands methods for data acquisition in order to reduce the errors that are more often encountered.The methodology detects the wetlands in the given images and it compares with the data of different time periods using the HSV color model, such that it can able to track down the amount of changing area. Hence the methodology detects the wetlands, estimates the change in the area of the water bodies, and provides the current information on wetlands in the Denduluru region.

articleTitle: Big Data Security: Detect and Prevent the Data from Attacks with Digital Forensic Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The main objective of this research is to defend big data against various cyberattacks. Today, it is commonplace to use big data security to safeguard data and analytical processes against malicious activity. Cybercriminals are increasingly using fraudulent calls and texts and other techniques to steal users' private information. Nowadays, these attacks are increasingly frequently online. This study has found various security technologies and strategies that are being utilized to make big data more secure from our prior research references. This study has also learnt about digital forensics tools that may be used to identify who, where, and how an attack was conducted. The fields of data science and cybersecurity are combined in this study. Detecting attacks on big data and ensuring and mitigating data security using cybersecurity and digital forensics techniques are the key goals of this study.

articleTitle: Fishermen and Fishing Boat Monitoring System using MIMO Technology and Database Management
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Identifying the boundary tends to be a serious issue for the fishermen that leads them into various troubles. In India, around 40-60 boats are seized and 250 + fishermen are getting arrested every year for being requested for crossing the boundary. The main cause of the problem is the communication gap between the coastal guards and fishermen. The proposed solution consists of four modules namely; the transceiver module, communication module, decision control module, and the database unit. The transceiver module is attached in fishing boats that consist of a QR code scanner, GPS module, RFID tag, and reader. Every fisherman is provided with a fisherman ID that has an RFID and unique QR code. The communication module consists of sea buoys with buoy repeaters, RFID tags, and readers. The fisherman ID and the transceiver module interact with the sea buoys present in the coastal region and, maintains the history of the arrival and departure of fishermen and the fishing boat and the same is recorded in the base station unit. Once the fishing boat crosses the warning limit, the alert message will be sent to the coastal guards through repeaters and the fuel valve of the boat will start to close. If the fishing boat crosses the fishermen’s limit, the rescue team gets into the rescue mission and the fuel valve of the boat will be closed. The proposed solution eases the work of the coastal guards by, providing automated database information. So that in case of rescue, it can be implemented immediately. This ensures the safety of the fishermen

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Product Reviews by using Naive Bayes and Vader Models
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Online web forums, blogs, and various social media platforms are now used by people to exchange ideas. Internet users occasionally offer reviews and thoughts on various products, brands, and their services. Not only do these product reviews enhance the quality of the product, but also have an impact on consumer purchase choices. Therefore, product review analysis is a well-liked platform where consumers can quickly become aware of their needs. Using the NRC emotion vocabulary, which can be divided into eight fundamental emotions and two sentiments, the six most popular items and consumers are chosen based on the plain text review. The eight different emotion groups in this research, are compared by using word clouds. In this study, 256,059 users and 74,258 products are followed for ten years, and 568,454 reviews of exquisite food are collected. The findings demonstrate how sentiment analysis may be used to pinpoint consumer habits and reduce risks in order to satisfy customers.

articleTitle: Application of YOLOv3 in Lung Nodule Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In the recent days, cancer has become one of the leading causes of death in the world. Lung cancer is among the major cancer types that has paralyzed the world with high mortality rate. If detected early, it increases the chance of survival dramatically. A customized deep learning framework called You Only Look Once (YOLOv3) is employed to detect the lung(pulmonary) nodules from the lung CT scan with high sensitivity and precision. The YOLOv3, with its deep neural network architecture was able to detect the nodules with sensitivity of 0.961 and precision of 0.9589.

articleTitle: Application of Bayesian Regularization ANN for the Classification of HLHS Anomaly Images
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Congenital Heart Disease (CHD) is one of the severe structural abnormalities which cause neonatal mortality. The severity of CHD depends on the early stage, moderate stage, and advanced stage of diseases. According to the cardiological society of India (CS1), the variation of incidence is about 74/2000 live births present at the time of birth. Among the different CHD's, Hypoplastic Left Heart Syndrome (HLHS) is considered a significant cyanotic heart disease. HLHS is a congenital disability that affects normal blood flow through the heart. The sonographic marker for HLHS identification is the underdevelopment of the lefl ventricle. Even though ultrasound devices are there to scan the fetus growth, it is still challenging due to the inherent speckle noise, continuous movement of the fetus and low quality of ultrasound devices used for scanning. So, an optimization methodology is still in demand for these kinds of problems. This paper combines different optimization techniques such as fast non-local mean denoising (FNLM) methodology for reducing the speckle noise, active geodesic contouring to segment the left ventricle for sonographic identification of HLHS and ANN with Bayesian Regulaiization for classifying the normality and abnormality present in the dataset. The dataset consists of 569 four-chamber view (4CV) ultra sound images for training and testing. The five different features used for evaluation are radius, texture, perimeter, smoothness, and symmetry. 80% of the data are used for training, and 20% for testing. The ANN Bayesian model numerically calculates the mean squared error (MSE) of 0. 01S and classifies the abnormality with an accuracy of 97%. This model gives a second opinion for medical practitioners and gynecologists.

articleTitle: Various Methods in Texture Analysis and Classification Techniques used in Cervical Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Cancer is one of the deadliest diseases which puts human life at risk. Among various types of cancer, the most common malignancy among women that results in mortality is cervical cancer. Early detection of Cervical cancer is hard to detect because it does not have any external manifestation of the disease. A Pap smear is one of the clinical procedures to find cervical cancer but it is not accurate always. Also, it is a very sensitive process and also consumes a lot of time. Several diagnostic techniques like MRI, CT, etc, can be used with various imaging methods to detect cervical cancer. This review paper aims at analyzing various images acquired by imaging tools for the detection of malignant tissues in the cervical region using image processing techniques and feature extraction techniques. The work also gives a comprehensive study on Texture analysis and methods used in the classification of textured images using AI, Machine learning, and deep learning processes.

articleTitle: An Advanced Analyzation of Ultrasonic Sound Detection and Ranging Method using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Sonars are being used in underwater search and rescue efforts, especially those involving airplanes, shipwrecks, and choking patients. In the event that a pursuit lasts for an extended period of time, when sonar administrators may get exhausted and ignore a potential object, object identification or characterization techniques might be of great aid. Sonar is a relatively new technical innovation that helps humans locate submarines, fish, and shipwrecks, as well as survey the ocean floor and accomplish other nautical objectives. The presentation of a sonar system is essentially determined by four factors: a powerful transmitter, a transducer, a sensitive collector, and an acoustic correspondence system. Even though modern sonar systems are limited to a predetermined number of elements, such as a two-layered screen and a view of less than 360 degrees of the surrounding area, it is possible to develop improved sonar systems with a three-layered screen that can be integrated with new PC frameworks and a 360-degree view of the surrounding area in the near future. Investigation and inspection at sea pose a formidable obstacle for the sector at present. The subsurface instruments and estimations are being enhanced as a consequence of ongoing improvements or the creation of new ones in order to meet the requirements of the newly founded maritime enterprise.

articleTitle: Dynamic Grouping of Players and Analysis for Regional Tournaments
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this research work, the effective integration of the current management system in local tournaments, the construction of a general mode, and the design and implementation of tools for local tournaments to realize the management system are explained in detail. In this paper, the problems of the current tournament system are considered by analyzing the technology of the tournament management system and the situation of local tournaments. Therefore, this research study proposes a system for local tournament pairings with the features of addition, deletion, and updating of participant information, as well as several pairing features to ease the process of organizing the tournament. Single elimination is great when the organizer wants to get only one winner. Every match was exciting in terms of competitiveness. Match-Up Tournament pairing system will be an easy-to-use platform that aims to reduce the time-consuming process of manually pairing of candidates with pen & paper every time for each match and for every round. Currently, there is no solution that can solve the problem of manual pairing of participants and organize a match between them. In the proposed system, an organizer will have the option of either manual pairing or automatic pairing of candidates as per the requirements.

articleTitle: Detection of Land Cover Changes using Satellite Image Classification Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The land cover of an area refers to its surface coverage, such as grasslands, housing areas, or water bodies. Changes take place in the structure of a land cover over time due to various natural environmental variables and human actions. In addition, it affects the life cycle of that region and the plans of human authorities for that piece of land. In order to detect the changes in a land cover quickly and accurately, a model that detects the changes over two timestamps are required. Using satellite NAIP images, this paper uses two-time stamps to detect land cover changes over a region of land.

articleTitle: Delay Enhancement of Wallace Tree Multiplier with Binary to Excess-1 Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper, a modified Wallace tree multiplier with several adders is presented. In every microprocessor and DSP circuit, the multiplier performs a vital function. The delay in multipliers is caused by the operating speed constraints of adders; by replacing standard adders with advanced adders in the multiplier’s design, the total latency in the formation of partial products may be drastically decreased. In terms of memory and delay, the Wallace tree multiplier and the array multiplier are investigated. As wallace multiplier is preferable than array multiplier, the Wallace multiplier’s construction is proposed utilizing Kogge Stone Adder (KSA) and carry select adder (CSLA) with Binary to Excess-l converter (BEC). The findings demonstrate that the suggested multiplier with BEC is effective, with minimal latency and memory use. The suggested wallace multiplier is implemented in Verilog and simulated in XILINX. The multiplier performance is validated using the Spartan 3E FPGA package. The designed multiplier is highly desirable for high-speedapplications.

articleTitle: Bio Sensor Technology Applications and Development in Process Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Sensors, as the basic technology of Electronics, can not only endure harsh exterior environment tests, but also acquire information properly and promptly, which is a crucial assurance for electronics rapid development. India now produces different types of sensors, including force sensitivity, color sensitivity, biological sensitivity, sensitive to voltage, too. These sensors are being used in a growing number of applications. In order to speed up the development of high quality in the field of electronics, this study, which is based on the current use of sensors, examines the problems that exist in practical operation to scientifically point out the development direction of sensor technology.

articleTitle: Taxonomy on DSP Based Islanding Detection Techniques in Micro Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The DG paradigm, which combines renewable and non-renewable energy resources to create a Micro grid that can be run more safely and effectively using fast islanding detection methods, is being adopted by the majority of sophisticated power system networks. Several islanding detection methods like Conventional passive detection methods having large Non detection zone (NDZ) with irregular threshold settings. The active detection techniques having intentional perturbation causing major disadvantage in improved rapid operation of Microgrid. In this concern with improved efficiency, accuracy, and reliability have been proposed in the literature. Signal Processing (SP) based passive Islanding detection Techniques are extensively analyzed by proper comparison under various aspects which is feasible and economical and can avoid the above said drawbacks for stable operations. This paper’s major contribution is to provides operation of islanding detection technique for voltage and current signals generated at point of common coupling with DSP based method which can compare the detection time which is the part of various Transformation techniques which has approached.

articleTitle: An Efficient and Robust Modified Hybrid Multipliers with Less Power and Better Speed
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The multiplier is the building block of all arithmetic circuits, and it is widely employed in CPUs and other types of digital processing units as well as in certain kinds of integrated circuits. How quickly and how much energy a CPU uses up are indicators of its effectiveness. The multiplier circuit uses several adders, which increases the hardware complexity and hence slows down the processing and causes it to spend a lot of energy. Power efficiency and speed of the multiplier module must be drastically increased. In this study, a hybrid wallace tree multiplier of 8 bits is proposed. The central concept is to include a Single bit Hybrid Full Adder (HFA) based on the power-efficient Gate Diffusion Input (GDI) technique to create a Hybrid Array Wallace tree (HAWT) with fewer transistors and Maxresulting voltage swing. Simulated findings demonstrate significant gains over the state-of-the-art when comparing the suggested design executed in Tanner EDA at 250nm technology.

articleTitle: Augmented Random Search based Autonomous Driving System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The development of autonomous driving technology led to a rise in the popularity of self-driving automobiles. CARLA is an open-source simulator for autonomous driving research and is used in these autonomous driving systems. From the beginning, CARLA has supported the creation, instruction, and testing of autonomous driving systems. Along with this, CARLA offers free to use open digital assets (such as city plans, structures, and vehicles). To perform addition and deletion of random sounds from the weight and tracking the entire rewards received as a result of this weight modification, the Augmented Random Search (ARS) approach trains a supervised learning on input data. The Augmented Random Generator is then used to measure the weights depending on these incentives in a predetermined number of episodes at a predestined learning rate. The Algorithm for Robotic Search (ARS) will be used to train self-driving cars. Automobiles based on data received from each car’s front cameras. As a result of this research, a framework for training self-driving cars has been developed. Carla’s policy employing ARS will be created with it as the core algorithm, giving a more realistic picture of how things work. Because of its novelty, ARS is an extremely light tool for analyzing difficult control tasks, and the authors of the study discovered that ARS had at least 15 times the computing efficiency of the fastest competitive learning approaches. CARLA has been used to provide more consistent results from autonomous vehicle training, and this research has proved successful considering how many unique circumstances there are, in opening up the majority of the chances for additional study on the same issue.

articleTitle: Implementation of PV Integrated Power Quality Enhancement and Performance Analysis of Battery Operated Electric Vehicle using Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative concept of photovoltaic system which includes the voltage quality issue that is rectified by active power filter. This method is useful for electric vehicle charging by using boost converter. The concepts like performance analysis of battery, increasing the efficiency of a non-linear loads and improving the power quality by using the boost converter algorithm is proposed. A Constant charging is required for EV charging which is achieved by the combination of solar PV array, Lithium Ferro Phosphate battery as battery energy storage (BES) and boost converter. By using Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT), the effective battery charging is executed. The threephase pulse width modulation inverter helps in maintaining the power quality enhancement and also used to charge the electric vehicle in AC supply. This work is carried out by the matlab Simulink. And also, with the execution of THD analysis, the harmonic distortion is reduced.

articleTitle: A Design-Aware Parasitic-Aware Simulation-Based Tool for the Design of RF Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper, a tool for the design of RF amplifiers is proposed. The motivation of this paper is to decrease the time taken for the design of RF amplifiers, to provide accurate designs by including parasitic modelling within the optimization process, and to guarantee the avoidance of infinite optimization loops during design automation. Designaware optimization guarantees reaching optimum design parameters in a short time. It avoids the entrance to no-solution space which is a challenge when using random optimization algorithms. The offered tool gives design flexibility when compared to template-based algorithms. Parasitic-aware optimization guarantees achieving accurate designs that result in the same performance after post layout simulations. Using an RF simulator for evaluation guarantees a high level of accuracy. The tool designs RF amplifiers that operate up to 15GHz. The tool validation is carried out designing three 65nm TSMC CMOS RF amplifiers operating at 7GHz, lOGHz, and 13GHz. The required performance specifications, entered to the tool for validation, were achieved. The required specifications were a minimum OPldB of10 dBm, a minimum gain of10 dB, and a minimum OIP3 of 20 dBm.

articleTitle: An Optimal Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Neural Network Model for Crop Yield Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Crop yield forecasting acts as a vital part of farm management, domestic food supply, global food trade, ecological sustainability, etc. Several features which affect the crop yield are plantation region, competence of irrigation system, variation in rainfall and temperature, soil quality and fertilization, and diseases. An automated crop yield prediction model using machine learning and deep learning approaches is necessary for effective decision making in agriculture. In this view, this study designs an optimal bidirectional gated recurrent neural network (OBGRNN) based crop yield prediction model. The goal of the OBGRNN technique is to forecast the crop yield using histoiical farming data. The OBGRNN technique performs two processes namely prediction and parameter optimization. At the initial stage, the BGRNN technique is applied for the actual prediction of the crop yield. Besides, in the next stage, the Differential Evolution (DE) is applied for the effectual tuning of the parameters involved in the BGRNN technique. The OBGRNN technique involves two processes namely prediction and parameter optimization and helps to improve the performance. A series of simulations were performed on the benchmark test dataset and the experimental values reported the better performance over the other techniques.

articleTitle: Optimizing Predictive Analytics Model (PAM) using Hyper-Parameter Tuning (HPT): A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: To predict a hidden pattern, predictive analytics models have been used in a variety of fields. The model’s hyper-parameter must be adjusted to make it suitable for solving a variety of challenges. The appropriate selection of hyper-parameters has a significant impact on the model’s predictive accuracy. To solve any problem efficiently, it is often necessary to have a thorough understanding of the predictive analytics model and hyper-parameter tuning strategies. This article investigates various algorithms associated with the predictive analytics model, as well as the method of identifying the appropriate hyper-parameters of the model. This study will assist data analysts and researchers in selecting the best hyper-parameters for their predictive analytics models in order to find meaningful hidden patterns.

articleTitle: Activity Scheduling Method for Cloud-based Data Centers with Quality Performance Employing References Queues
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The existing network architecture is enhanced by novel techniques like the cloud computing network because the network technology is advancing rapidly. The cloud computing system is made up of multiple processors and memory, faster networking, and different programming activities that enable it to offer people a variety of facilities through the Internet. But, at the same time, most services look for ideal service nodes, and the workloads on every node may not be evenly distributed. The Fitness Scheme Queues Select Instruments and Orientation Queue established Cloud Facility Architecture are designed to support more activities, reduce the time span, and enhance performances. Additionally, work might be split up more equitably to prevent overload.

Author Keywords: Orientation Queue established Cloud Facility Architecture
Active Election tool and Load Balancing

articleTitle: Football Player Substitution Analysis using NLP and Survival Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Football player substitution is extremely significant in situations where the team is down by goals or attempting to retain a lead that can add value to the team’s performance. However, substituting players based on their prior performance would not assist the squad in making good decisions. In one of the papers, they used an inverse gaussian hazard model to determine the survival rate of players. However, the main issue arises when players do not give their all due to their mental state, which plays a critical role during the game. Furthermore, most of the research papers relied solely on past performance of players and various analyses, which was insufficient. This study discovered that the player’s mindset should be mentally stable and competitive which is also very crucial during the match by reading various research articles. Hence, this study proposes a framework which comprises of two models, namely Survival Analysis (Kaplan-Meier Fitter) and Natural Language Processing (Sentimental Analysis). Sentimental Analysis would hel p in determining a player’s mindset before the match and Kaplan-Meier Fitter is used to find out the survival rate of player’s performance based on several factors like goal scored, passing accuracy etc. which would allow the team to make better informed decisions. Comparison of these two models would yield the best results for substitute players on the bench on the basis of their past performance and their mental health which will allow them to make team management to make better judgments.

articleTitle: Improved EMD Algorithm for Electrocardiogram Denoising and Feature Extraction for Detection of Cardiovascular Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The electrocardiogram (ECG) is an exceptionally well-known technique that has been utilized as an essential methodology of finding of cardiovascular conduction issues, by methods for the investigation of the pulse and the morphological examination of different heart imperfections. Wavelet denoising is one of the denoising techniques normally utilized for ECG signals. Nonetheless, because of the recurrence cover between the EMG and ECG, the weak qualities of ECG signals exist the danger of being debilitated during the time spent sifting clamour. The commotion decrease in the ECG has been one of the primary fields of examination lately, for the area that the ideal decrease permits a decent prepreparing of the sign. This cycle can be valuable in separating the greatest measure of proficient and significant data. The work proposes a novel strategy for ECG clamour decrease utilizing empirical mode decomposition (EMD) and discrete wavelet transform (DWT) based versatile edge method which is advanced with Cultural Algorithm. The presentation assessment boundaries sign to noise ratio (SNR) and mean square error (MSE) are determined, in view of the analysis with MIT-BIH (Massachusetts Institute of Technology-Beth Israel Hospital) information base. Further this separated signal is prepared for figuring of attributes of the heartbeat: complex QRS, P, S and T waves, just as pulse with DWT Discrete Wavelet Transform and DTCWT (Dual Tree Complex Wavelet Transform). Hence the proposed technique suppresses the noises like baseline wandering, power-line interferences and produces the signal quality, SNR as 35 dB. The produced signal quality helps the physicians to read and diagnose the ECG for identifying cardiac anomalies.

articleTitle: Throughput Performance of 802.11e for Different Versions of Wi-Fi Standard
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The IEEE 802. 11e amendment offers Quality of Service for WLAN applications when traffic of different priorities is present in the network. A mechanism called enhanced distributed channel access (EDCA) that combines both point coordination function (PCF) and distributed coordination function (DCF) functions of channel accessing is employed in this amendment. Through this, the high priority application traffic is offered more weightage when compared with the traffic of low priority applications. In this work, throughput performance of different Wi -Fi versions like 802. 11b, 11a, 1lg and 11n are investigated under varying traffic loads taking the priority feature of 802. 11e into consideration. It is found that the priority mechanism is more appropriate if the offered load to the network is high only.

articleTitle: TCAD Analysis of Substrate Thickness of a 10nm Vertical Double Gate SOI n-Type MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This work presents a performance analysis for a 10nm Metal Oxide Semiconductor Field Effect Transistor (MOSFET) and how it changes the characteristics with a change in the substrate thickness. Through this work the best performing design overall are the 4nm and 6nm thicknesses out of Snm, 6nm, 4nm, and 2nm designs tested. The Silicon On Insulator (SOI) technology used here is done for isolation of device from the base substrate. 2nm design shows best on current / off current ratio of approx. 57, but has higher subthreshold slope. Height of the transistor is 34nm from source to drain, and a thickness of 22nm for 8nm substrate and up to 16nm for 2nm substrate. 4nm design is selected as best with a transconductance value of almost 0.002 Ohm-l at a $\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{D}\mathrm{D}}$ of 1 Volt and at gate voltage of 0.9 Volt. On current of the 4nm design is highest at 1. 06mA. The 2nm design has lowest on current due to resistance of the silicon. Work function of 4.5 is used.

articleTitle: Detection and Diagnosis of Fetus Ultra Sound Images using Deep Learning Classification Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This research work proposes detection and diagnosis of Down syndrome using soft computing and deep learning algorithm. The detection module of the proposed DS classification system consists of Gabor transform, feature extractions and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) classification methods. The suggested system’s diagnosis module uses the ANFIS classifier to categorize abnormal foetus images into ‘‘Early’’ cases and ‘‘Advanced’’ situations. This approach uses CNN classification methodology to identify and segment the NT region. This methodology divides each pixel in a foetal picture into normal and abnormal pixels based on the derived feature set. Then, morphological segmentation method segments the region belonging to NT in classified abnormal fetus image

articleTitle: Differentially Distributed Private Intelligence Security in Cybersecurity Infrastructures
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Novel ways of security against attacks to critical infrastructure are becoming more important as their number and sophistication increase. In order to provide the kind of security that is necessary, one must consider both preventive measures and an understanding of the current state of affairs inside the systems being protected. Researches and institutions have brought security solutions that are both intelligent and selfsufficient, such as the necessity for sophisticated proactive monitoring capability in Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS). This study argues that critical infrastructures need automated IDS solutions and that adding Machine Learning (ML) approaches into IDS will be useful for developing dynamically adjustable algorithms that can promptly respond to changing circumstances and threats. To this end, this study assesses the several degrees of automation provided by the IDS and provide a plan for introducing preemptive automation into critical settings. Finally, this study evaluates how well the proposed method stacks up against other methods previously presented in the literature. Machine learning presents difficulties in the field of cybersecurity that must be effectively addressed using sound methodology and theory. Transfer learning, support vector machines, and Bayesian classification are just a few examples of the statistical and machine learning approaches that have been shown to be useful in reducing the effects of cyberattacks. It is crucial to establish smart security systems that can discover hidden patterns and insights from packet headers and then construct a data-driven machine-learning model to avoid these assaults. This study examines the use of machine learning methods to cybersecurity data with the goal of bolstering the safety of existing infrastructures. This article has addressed the current state of cybersecurity threats as well as the deployment of machine learning methods to combat the aforementioned challenges.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Pre-Crash Detection System using Node MCU
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The proposed collision warning system can be added to various automotive applications. With this precrash detection system, a vehicle can detect and know the position, acceleration, speed, and movement of other vehicles up to certain kilometers under various situations. The situation may be a blind spot, vehicle stopped in a place hidden from view, or around a corner blocked by other vehicles. A vehicle prototype is created and tested under various conditions. The system will use a sonar sensor to identify impediments, and an Arduino is used to apply emergency braking when the situation arises. The device also will provide options for speed control to reduce damage or to avoid collision with another vehicle. Consequently, a fully accessible automated collision avoidance system is suggested. As a result, every car can now have an automated smart speed control and braking system so that it can help to avoid collision and proteus software was used in this study to create a prototype model.

articleTitle: Arduino based Smart Controller for Footwear Mat
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Washing footwear during the rainy season or when they become cumbersome due to dust/debris is time consuming. Its durability will be reduced if washed frequently. Based on the review, a smart mat to clean the dust particles and provide water to clean wet debris particle from footwear is proposed. This is a sensor based dry dust removal and wet debris removal by using ATmega328P microcontroller. This smart mat is operated by the power supply and by placing the foot on the smart mat to remove the debris/dust in bottom part of the footwear. Ultrasonic Sensor Module HC-SR04 -2 is used to detect the target (person). relav coil (5V) is used to operate switching mechanism. Air blower is used to blow out the sand and drv dust. Steel rod with brush activated bv DC motor through the simple gear train is used to suooIv water forciblv. The inlet and outlet facilities are used to provide water and remove dirt water. Smart cleaning matis designed to clean the debris/dirt stuck at the sole part of footwear to keep the interior environment clean and avoid slippery during walk on the floor. This makes the sole part of footwear clean and maintain a standard in every commercial and industrial sector by remaining hygiene. It is effective in commercial sites, hospitals, schools, colleges, public places, and homes. The proposed mat is effective against water, mud, oil and dirt out.

articleTitle: Highly Efficient 2.45 GHz Rectifier Circuit for RF Energy Harvesting Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The improved bridge rectifier shown in this study was built utilizing four Schottky diodes. In order to precisely forecast the rectifier performances, the Microwave rectifier has been simulated on Agilent ADS 2019 at 2.45 GHz with associated circuit techniques. Since the provided rectifier’s circuit is devoid of an HF filter and a bypass capacitor, it is both compact and effective. At 1.2 mW power at the input terminal, the circuit has a maximum efficiency of 52.248% while converting RF to DC.

Author Keywords: Radio Frequency to Direct Current converter

articleTitle: Design of Power, Control and Communication Module for Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Interleaved boost converters typically have smaller inductor volumes and weighs less than conventional PFC boost converters. To take advantage of these benefits, it is necessary to manage current correctly. Avoiding rough edges is ideal. Using Lyapunov-likelihood control, this paper proposes a controller for interleaved boost converters (IBCs), which provides stable output voltage. Boost cells follow their own set of rules, as well as they share the current in its own. Logic switches will also be integrated into the IBC. Decrease consumption ripple to the greatest degree. Using simulations, the performance of the system is tested and a suitable control and switching logic design is recommended. A Power, Control, and Communication Module for Equipment (EVSE) was proposed, which uses energy to charge electric vehicles that have various requirements. Considering the rapid rise of electric vehicles, this study focuses on the challenges and obstacles associated with creating a more comprehensive EV charging network. The desired power is controlled by a power controller for EVs. To ensure safety between electric vehicles and charging stations, a PFC controller and full bridge LLC converter are proposed. Using these modules, a single socket can charge electric vehides of any type, reducing the number of connections.

Author Keywords: Power Factor Correction with IBC Converter

articleTitle: Advancements in PV Technology- Floating Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: New technology allows for the generation of power from Solar power conversion systems using floating photovoltaic (FPV) systems. Even more so now that floating photovoltaic systems are predicted to eliminate the requirement for land area for installation, it is essential to evaluate the current status and future projections for scientific advances in solar power generation with real worth solutions. Solar energy can be captured using floating PV plant innovation in India, a country with a large energy requirement but limited available urban barren land for photovoltaic power farms. Many river bodies, critical to improving the standard of living for a large population, flow through India, making it one of the fortunate countries. Floating solar plants, also known as solar arrays atop floating platforms on river systems, are frequently favored by the administration as a means of achieving sustainable goals. This study examines the current state of solar energy in India and other developed nations, and it looks ahead to the potential for widespread solar power use in the future. Topics covered range from solar panel infrastructure to environmental impacts and coastal energy management. An overview of FPV setup and panel tilt angle for optimal placement is provided.

articleTitle: A Novel Converter Design for Energy Management in Electrical Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In the modern era, electric vehicles play a vital role because of their eco-friendly features. In this proposed study, an EV is equipped with a supercapacitor and battery. Also, these configurations are powered by solar PV with a quasi- Z source converter. The proposed methodology delivers uninterrupted power to the EV and the braking conditions regenerative energy is stored with the bi-directional converter. The proposed converter doesn’t need any additional equipment for bidirectional power flow. A Centre tapped High-Frequency Transformers (HFT) are intended for isolation purposes. The secondary side of HFT provides bi-directional power flow in different ecological conditions. The proposed methodology’s performance investigation is obtained with various stages to verify its adequateness. The entire model is developed with the help of Matlab/Simulink. The converter’s efficiency depends on its bi-directional power flow and transient conditions.

articleTitle: Blood and Plasma Donation, Management System with Global Positioning System using FIREBASE
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Blood is essential to the human body, and so is plasma. According to National Blood Transfusion Council, people who are above 18 years are eligible to donate blood. According to 2021 population statistics, nearly 139 crores of people are above 18. Despite the count, only 2.5 crore units of blood are available at blood centers. Some of the previous systems have provided either donor information or else blood bank information. But most of the systems haven’t provided both. So, this study has developed a multi-page application that can provide the donor’s information application is named DONORS QUEST, where a seeker can search for the right donor in a fraction of a second. The GPS plays a major well in the bank information with the location. This web role is for tracking the location of donors. The current application is a free and open-source web application developed using the MERN stack. The users can get the details of the donors rapidly. Our web application provides a better platform for interaction between the seeker and donor in case of an emergency. Firebase provides reliable, extensible databases and fast hosting. With this application, anyone of legal age is welcome to donate blood to donors. With one login, all the seekers can get the details of available donors. If the seeker can’t find the donor with desired blood group, then they can search for nearby blood and plasma banks with the help of GPS. Firebase helps rapidly host the web application in a fraction of a second. Firebase helps developers to concentrate on innovation rather than thinking about infrastructure.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based Electronics Engineering Software Application System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Science and technology are in a rapid development stage as a result of the advancement and progress of the times, and it is clear that the contemporary civilization has entered the era of Artificial Intelligence (AI). This research focuses on AI applications in the context of Industry 4.0 concept. This current work discusses AI acceptance in the manufacturing industry and its promotion in intelligence optimization. The Virtual model concept is presented to improve the rationale of various interfaces. The communication and information intelligence AI algorithms are examined in depth. The concept of a smart city and AI applications, as well as how AI plays a role in its implementation have been discussed.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Weather Prediction using Error Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Weather prediction is actually a tedious task, it is a tough task not only for the common man but also for the researcher scientists. So as to predict the most accurate weather, machine learning techniques are used to make an error prediction based on the given data. In this study, the meteorological and geographic data of the past 30 years were collected, and five machine learning algorithms were used: linear regression (LR), polynomial regression (PR), random forest regression (RFR), decision tree regression (DTR), random forest dept. The dataset used in the research is taken from Kaggle and contains 96454 instances and 12 attributes. Machine-learning algorithms were selected as regression models to predict weather. Additionally, grid search and five-fold cross-validation techniques were used to improve learning performance. Model performance was evaluated by comparing the observed and predicted data. It was observed that the Random Forest (RF) with maximum Dept-50 model accurately predicted the error with accuracy of 0.0019 compared with other models with various statistical criteria.

articleTitle: Adaptive Speed Controller for Electric Vehicle using ADAS Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Statics says about 1214 (approx.) accidents are occurring every day in Indian roads. Electric vehicle comes to existence but its safety infrastructure is not well versed yet. Some peoples are hesitating to use Electric vehicle due to the lack of safety features. To improve the Electric vehicle safety, vehicle should be partially automated. So far Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) is treated as fancy or optional feature. Therefore, to solve this issue ADAS specific controller is developed for 2 - wheelers, 3- wheelers and 4- wheelers. The 3-phase inverter for BLDC motor is interfaced with Lidar, Radar, Camera, and algorithm. These sensor helps to sense the external parameter like other vehicles, pedestrians, board signs and other road barriers. The ADAS features are Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), Driver Drowsiness Detection (DDD), Forward Collision Warning System (FCWS), Parking Assistant (PA), Lane Departure Early Warning System (LDEWS). In this paper, Adaptive Cruise Control is simulated using MATLAB - Simulink which is used to sense the forward vehicle’s speed and control our vehicle’s speed according to the situation. These decisions are made by the Microcontroller and decision-making algorithm which implemented within the ADAS system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Impacts of Various Masks on Human Health using IoT Device
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In general, the protective masks are used to lower the chances of the virus entering our respiratory system. Nowadays, wearing face masks is highly recommended in crowded places. People have been wearing different types of masks such as N95, surgical masks, cloth masks etc. to protect themselves from airborne foreign bodies. In this work, an Internet of Things (IoT) based human vital sign monitoring system is designed and developed. Further, the impacts of various masks such as cloth masks, surgical masks and N95 masks on human health are analyzed. Results demonstrate that the wearing of cloth mask impacts more on human SpO2 levels when compared to the other masks namely surgical masks and N95 masks. Also, it is seen that the wearing of various masks doesn’t affect the human heart beat rate.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of NOMA_OFDM based MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The development of 5G wireless communication systems will be significantly impacted by non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA’S), one of the newest and most promising multiple access technologies. A survey of the literature on NOMA in relation to the 5G communication network is provided in this study. It also offers a methodical way to examine the variations between NOMA and OMA. Mathematical equations are used to show a thorough description of the downlink system model. The user pairing and power allocation design for resource in the form of a non-convex optimization problem, allocation is presented. In general, there are no systematic methods for efficiently& effectively resolving challenges of this nature. Thus, according to the methodologies, resource allocation with reduced computing complexity is devised.

articleTitle: Dynamic Transmit Awake Feature based Forwarder Election in Mobile WSN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Mobile Wireless Sensor Network (MWSNs) is the collection of wireless mobile sensor nodes that are able to dynamically form a short-term network. Because of its dynamic nature, MWSN is self-configuring and obtaining the secure route is very challenging. The traditional routing efficiency approaches are not adequate for the protected routing of information from sender to receiver in MWSN since it necessitates refined hardware, software, great memory, speed of high processing, and transmission bandwidth. The major challenge of designing and developing WSNs for industrial supervising and control is fulfilling their strict stability necessities. Also, the network’s stability is greatly affected and challenged in MWSN. In this paper, Dynamic Transmit Awake Feature (DTAF)-based forwarder election in mobile WSN is proposed. The DTAF approach aims to improve routing efficiency and minimize link failure in industrial applications. Here, the forwarder node is chosen along with the Transmit Awake Feature (TAF). This TAF is evaluated by the sensor node link weight, received signal strength, Expected Transmission count, and available throughput by applying the Cuckoo search (CS) algorithm. This approach improves the whole network’s lifespan and connectivity. Furthermore, it increases the network stability and selects an efficient relay. The network simulator tool is used for verifying the DTAF performance. Simulations results evaluate the DTAF approach provides better-remaining energy, better throughput, and lesser packet delay.

articleTitle: Hyper Automation and Augmented Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The state-of-the-art technologies, hyperautomation and augmented intelligence, have the potential to completely transform the way in which organizations operate and humans interact with technology. Previously, hyper automation used advanced technologies like AI and robotic process automation to automate manually performed processes and tasks. Simultaneously, Augmented Intelligence utilizes AI to improve human intelligence and decision-making. This article investigates the potential benefits and drawbacks of these technologies, as well as the challenges and opportunities. It also discusses about the role of government and industry in promoting a responsible hyper automation and augmented intelligence development and deployment.

articleTitle: Importance of Phasor Measurement Unit in Modern Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Indian Power system is now emerging as a vast power system infrastructure. A competent power system infrastructure is needed for efficient and reliable operation. Smart Grid technology is at the deployment stage as far as the Indian scenario is concerned. PMU is a major component of the smart grid. This paper highlights the role of the Phasor Measurement Unitin the Modern Power System.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Different Fatty Acid Vegetable Oil using Ranking Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Vegetable oil technology is the most feasible solution for high-voltage liquid dielectrics. For the past few years, conventional mineral oil has been mainly used in transformer protection and coolant applications. According to a recent survey, demand is increasing due to population growth and the limited availability of coal and mineral renewable sources. Researchers can concentrate on environmentally friendly solutions. The objective of this research is to evaluate the effectiveness of liquid insulation using a number of different vegetable oils with fatty acids. The liquid insulation samples for this study will be made from a mixture of saturated and unsaturated vegetable oil. With a particular category of vegetable oil–palm and coconut oil (saturated fatty acids), peanut oil (mono unsaturated fatty acids), sunflower, soy bean, and sesame oil–characteristics such as viscosity, flash point, and pour point have been examined (poly unsaturated fatty acids). The effectiveness of oil sample performance has been classified, and the best sample is determined using the ranking technique.

articleTitle: A Novel Communication using WWSN with Intelligent Controller Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: To investigate the viability of implementing a communication-based protection system for fishermen. This system was designed with the welfare of fishermen in mind. Overall, it’s an effort to create a practical, low-cost, and straightforward tool for fishermen. In some media, additionally the infrared and sound waves can be comparable. The system is built so that the information collected by sensors both on the ground and in the air can be shared seamlessly. Small sound waves present on the top of the sea are proportional to the 1s and 0s being communicated, which are produced by an underwater transmitter to the surface.

articleTitle: Android based Smart System for Vehicle Garage
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: There are various reasons for a vehicle to abruptly stop. In such a state, the user cannot locate a workstation instantly. This necessitates the development of an Android-based application to allow customers to easily locate nearby mechanics, and then contact them via internet. In this research work, an Android-based model has been developed to track and locate a nearby vehicle workstation. The software will allow the car's owner to locate and contact any nearby vehicle service center. Both the user and the mechanic can access each other's whereabouts by using the application's Google Maps functionality by saving more time in the difficult situation. As a result, the proposed method is compatible with modern technology and is also user-friendly, informative and saves more time.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement of Standalone Microgrid during Faults on Distribution Line with DSTATCOM
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The voltage control of a wind energy based hybrid standalone Microgrid subjected to the faults on distribution feeders is presented in this paper. The effects of faults on the Microgrid are analyzed and required control measures are implemented to stabilize the turbine speed as well as to improve the quality of voltage at AC load bus. The controller of the existing maximum power point tracker (MPPT) is modified to limit the turbine speed during the fault(s). Distribution static shunt compensator (DSTATCOM) is further considered at AC load bus to provide the support for stabilizing the voltage during faults. Its novel control is presented to maintain the PCC voltages within allowable limits after occurrence of fault. Moreover, the connected DSTATCOM can also compensate for the reactive power demanded by the load. Further, with the help of DSTATCOM, torque pulsations induced in the generator due to unbalanced load are reduced. Fuel Cell and Electrolyzer are incorporated into the system to supply the reliable power at the load bus. The performance of Fuel Cell and Electrolyzer is also evaluated under the condition of fault. Extensive results based on case studies are presented in this paper with the help of MATLAB/SIMULINK package. The performances of proposed controllers are examined under unbalanced load as well as under different faults to show the satisfactory responses.

Author Keywords: Reactive Power and Unbalanced Load Compensation

articleTitle: Implementation of Kidney Stone Detection using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The global incidence of kidney stones continues to rise annually, making it one of the leading causes of pain and disability among people of all ages. Kidney disease is distinct from problems affecting other organ systems. Inherited and hereditary diseases of the kidneys are the most common categories. In medicine, kidney disease is defined as a diverse array of factors that impair kidney function and structure. In recent years, it has become clear that even minor deviations from the norm in kidney structure and capacity are associated with an increased risk of creating entanglements in other organ frameworks, and ultimately, death. Continuous refers to a duration of more than three months, while intense refers to a duration of three months or less. Disabilities can be broken down into their component parts and organized according to their structure, function, cause, duration, and outcomes. To accommodate the rapidly growing data base in clinical prescribing and research, new ordering frameworks are constantly being developed. The Region of Interest (ROI) algorithm uses adversarial examples to determine the optimal weight parameters, and then a convolutional neural network (CNN) is used to perform the classification. When compared to using either method alone, ROI+CNN yields improved accuracy (99.85%), specificity (99.68%), sensitivity (99.9%), FPR (0.0032%), and FNR (0.0%).Because so much about conventional practices is no longer a 1%, its false-acceptance rate is also 100%. A comparison of the proposed method’s precise counting stage with that of existing methods is displayed here. Therefore, the probabilistic advances delivered enhanced outcomes for KIDNEY datasets, and supplementary analysis can yield useful insights for diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: A Review on Optical Amplifiers for Future Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper, a study on various optical amplifiers (OAs) for future optical networks has been presented. OAs are significant and critical components for optical networks. It helps in signal amplification without converting the input signals into electrical. Thus, in this paper, a comprehensive review on latest OAs and their features, the significant applications of these amplifiers have been studied. It is analyzed that out of all amplifiers, hybrid amplifier helps to extend the transmission range between transmitter and receiver over wired and wireless access networks.

articleTitle: Software Risk Ranking Assessment Model using Fuzzy Decision-Making Trial and Evaluation Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: To ensure the quality of the software development process by developing an effective risk management framework. Project development, programs, and organizational activities are strongly influenced by the presence of hazardous events. Project success can be attributed to prioritizing project risk. Therefore, non-eliminable software risks must be given significant priority for the full success of the project. In this study, a risk assessment in a software project is conducted by evolving with a fuzzy basis. The life of software development includes a number of key software programs that greatly support the decision-making process. The most important and inevitable major software projects are identified and gradation by using methods the decision-making is unclear, make decisions, and laboratory evaluation (fuzzy DEMATEL) to assess the risk of the project. NASA’s data, 93 projects is used to carry out experimental validation. The results obtained show that project implementation is achieved by a set of factors called software risk factors. The experimental results showed improvements in risk assessment of the project application.

Author Keywords: Fuzzy Decision-Making Trial and Evaluation Laboratory

articleTitle: Comparative Model of Offline Signature Verification System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Among other types of biometric recognition systems like fingerprint, voice, iris, etc., signature verification is the most frequently used biometric type. Authenticating a handwritten signature can be made easier by using the proposed Signature Verification System (SVS), which minimizes human error. The proposed system helps in determining how closely the user's new signature resembles the previous signature stored in the database. Biometric verification technologies include voice recognition, iris scanning, face recognition, and finger print scanning, among others. However, not all systems are portable, and some have very high deployment costs. This study investigates the signature verification system that can be used to achieve beneficial results in order to increase efficacy, efficiency, and portability. This is accomplished by comparing the Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) and the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).

Author Keywords: SSIM-Structural Similarity Index Measure CNN-Convolutional Neural Network.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Five Level Buck Boost Converter for Grid Connected Hybrid Power System using Matlab/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This research describes a revolutionary voltage-lift switched inductor (VLSI) cell-based high step-up DC-DC multilevel buck-boost converter. Cascade of traditional DC-DC converters is not a workable solution to reach high conversion ratio. In this study, a VLSI cell is used to improve the multilevel buck-boost converter’s boost capabilities. The suggested DC-DC multilevel topology’s key benefit is that it achieves large conversion ratios without the use of coupled inductors, transformers, or high duty cycles. The 200W-rated buck-boost multilevel converter that is being suggested has three stages and a 220V output voltage. The duty cycle is 70%, the switching frequency is 50 kHz, and the input supply voltage is 12 V.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition using Mel Frequent Cepstral Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The ability to articulate one’s research and ideas is dependent on one’s communication skills. When it comes to human dispatches, voice is by far the most common and consequential. Emotional vaticination prediction is the process of determining a speaker’s emotional state from their words. Thus, improved human-computer trade is the result. Predicting someone’s emotional state can be tough due to the subjective nature of emotions and the difficulty of capturing reflection audio, but Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) has made it possible. Increasing the level of understanding and communication between humans and machines is driving research into the field of emotion recognition in speech. People’s emotional states can be gleaned from their tonalities, pitches, facial expressions, behaviours, and other states. Unfortunately, only a small fraction of these is believed to be capable of identifying vocal expressions of emotion. Classifiers are educated to identify emotional tones in spoken language with minimal data

articleTitle: Arduino based Zero Emission Residential Home for Sustainable Township
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The concern for sustainability has grown in recent years. With recent infrastructure development, the government is focusing on sustainable infrastructure, which gives rise to development in all dimensions, including the environment, economy, and society. This paper examines a zeroemission residential home for a smart township project.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Speech Recognition Algorithm for a Bionic Arm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This study concentrates on developing a deep-learning-based speech recognition algorithm that can be deployed on a bionic arm in the local language for an upper arm amputee. The speech recognition system ensures optimum performance with predefined actions based on the commands. The targeted operations to be done with the bionic arm are holding, gripping, giving, and fetching. CNN was used to develop a machine learning-based speech recognition model and it was incorporated into the bionic arm. For this, the Arduino nano ble 33 speech recognition module is used to control the arm based on the command given. The same was extended with coding and assembly modifications. In response, the arm responded to its predefined actions for the commands it has been programmed with.

articleTitle: A Fog Computing based Agriculture-IoT Framework for Detection of Alert Conditions and Effective Crop Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The Internet of Things, a new world in computer networks, is growing more and more significant due with its vast range of applications in goal-oriented initiative advances. People nowadays have access to remotely applications that include agriculture, environmental sensing, integrated solutions, as well as smart cities due to the Internet of Things. These are the modern, advanced technologies that make things simple. The IoT must have effectively improved the number and diversity of connected gadgets, resulting in an attractive trend. The fog computing paradigm, which is also a relatively recent invention mostly in computer industry, can efficiently supplement conventional cloud platform with much more sustainable technologies. Despite its low environmental impact, fog computing can potentially be extremely important for the development of smart agriculture. In this work, introducing a fog-based internet of things architecture that takes advantage of the fog as well as its services, lowering the amount of data relayed towards the cloud, enhancing computationally resource utilization. The increasing domain of smart agriculture, which involves all agriculture management approaches, is subject to the suggested fog computing methodology. Additionally, using this platform as a foundation, did simulations as well as illustrated how such fog computing strategy may signficantly minimise the quantity of data sent to the cloud. It also suggest as well as outline a proposed system that can detect the alert conditions over heterogeneous sensor data streams yielding effective crop protection.

Author Keywords: Applications of IoT in Smart Agriculture

articleTitle: Machine Learning and Deep Learning based Intrusion Detection in Cloud Environment: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Due to its open and dispersed nature, cloud computing (CC) faces several security-related difficulties. As a result, it is weak and open to breaches that compromise the security, reliability, and integrity of cloud resources and provided services. The most widely utilized element of computer system security and compliance procedures that protects cloud environments from numerous threats and attacks is the intrusion detection system (IDS). The goal of this article is to study how deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) networks are used by various methodologies at various stages of the intrusion detection process to get improved outcomes. The goal of this work is to discuss the state of the art for detectingintrusions usingavariety of techniques, including soft computing, data mining, and other approaches. The experimental findings demonstrate that unsupervised, deep learning-based techniques achieve superior accuracy of 99.95%.

articleTitle: Symmetrized Feature Selection with Stacked Generalization based Machine Learning Algorithm for the Early Diagnosis of Chronic Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Many healthcare sectors generate huge amount of healthcare data every day. To determine the risk of various chronic conditions, the collected data can be correctly analyzed using machine learning algorithms. Using machine learning algorithms, Health care analytics predicts the presence or absence of disease and detects various diseases. Health care analytics will improve patient care and medical practitioners’ decision-making process by performing early disease detection process. Stacking is a meta-learning-based transfer learning approach that combines various machine learning algorithms. The advantage of layered generalization is that it allows to use the predictive capability of different machine learning algorithms to develop intermediate solutions, which improves the overall performance of the model. The proposed method utilizes a symmetric feature selection algorithm to extract the appropriate features from the chronic disease dataset. The proposed algorithm determines the merit of the feature by considering the entropy and information gain of the individual features. Metaheuristic algorithms can solve a wide range of complex real-world issues with high quality. A stacked generalization-based meta heuristic algorithm is used in the proposed approach to predict the possibility of chronic diseases. The experiment makes use of chronic disease datasets from the kaggle repository. The experimental findings reveal that the proposed symmetrized feature selection algorithm in combination with Stacked generalization-based Metaheuristics technique has obtained a better accuracy than the existing approaches.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning based Malware Classification Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Rapid developments in the field of computer technology introduced new factors such as sophistication, effectiveness, and increased connectivity. The evolution in computer technology involuntarily leads to the evolution of malware as more devices are connected, leading to the development of malware that can spread through interconnected devices. The increase in the use of computers in almost every part of our life, people rely more on them by storing all the crucial details and information on the computers. This will put us in a vulnerable state where cybercriminals can attack us and exploit us using our data against us. These attacks can be performed by injecting various kinds of malware into our computers which puts us at risk. This creates the necessity to discover the different malicious attacks and classify them before it takes place to be safe. Representing the malware in a visual representation makes the process of classification much easy and more efficient. This research study proposes a neural network model to evaluate the performance of different combinations of various methods available for representing malware and different models of convolutional neural networks (CNN) and selects the best model that has highest accuracy.

articleTitle: A Review on Cyber Security and Anomaly Detection Perspectives of Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The substantial study that has been done for almost ten years on various power system issues has led to the smart grid (SG), Which is now being adapted in nations all over the world. Utilities play an important role as operators of critical infrastructure systems and provides of essential services. Cybaer-attacks may damage power grid due to Which widespread infrastructure failures may occur. The adoption of smart communication in such critical components, on the other hand, quickly raised a cybaer-security risk that needed to be addressed The cyber threat causes great danger to smart applications and may lead to the physical damage too. This study assesses and reports on cutting-edge methods for identifying cyber-attacks in SG areas, with a particular emphasis on machine learning-based systems.
